theme_strategy.art_direction_notes: A high-impact, award-worthy editorial layout inspired by Godly and Awwwards agency sites. High contrast monochrome base (#0A0A0A black and #F4F4F5 off-white) broken by aggressive Electric Lime (#CCFF00) kinetic triggers. No generic gradients. Strict 1px hairline grid borders, high density typography, asymmetrical spans, and line-by-line text reveals.

hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase leading-[0.95]
hierarchy.h3_subsection: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.25em] uppercase text-[#CCFF00]

grid_system.tetris_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: section padding py-20 lg:py-32, card internal padding p-6 lg:p-8.
layout_and_spacing.border_style: 1px solid #27272A grid borders and sharp 0px or subtle 4px corner radii (rounded-none or rounded-md)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling active globally for premium weight and momentum
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Line-by-line masked text reveal with staggered delay (staggerChildren: 0.12)
motion_and_interactions.button_interaction: On hover, arrow moves +4px right (`group-hover:translate-x-1.5 transition-transform duration-300`), button fill switches to Electric Lime with black text
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial drift using infinite flex translate or CSS animation with generous gap-16 and low opacity background outline text
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Subtle border lighting up to #CCFF00 with 1px inner stroke shift and light image scale (scale-105 transition-transform duration-500)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Header navigation has links to HOME | SERVICES | CLIENTS | ABOUT and a distinct CTA button LET'S TALK → that routes to /contact.
The sticky navigation must feature a solid or blurred dark background (bg-neutral-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-neutral-800) so links remain crisp.

In the Services page and Home services preview, clearly tag OTA MANAGEMENT with a prominent label 'HOSPITALITY', positioning it as a specialized hotel revenue & visibility service without giving the impression that Crazecation is hospitality-only.
Implement the Contact form so it submits via POST to /api/contact, stores the enquiry in MongoDB via FastAPI, and displays the exact requested success state: 'WE GOT IT. We'll get back to you soon.'
All client case studies and counter figures (20+ Brands, Multiple Industries, 100% Obsessed With Growth) must be editable placeholders without fabricated revenue or ROI statistics.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components (buttons, links, form inputs, navigation items, filter buttons) as required by guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid high contrast matte surfaces with subtle 1px border lines (#27272A).
DO NOT center-align main text or page containers globally; respect asymmetric editorial grid alignment.
Use Electric Lime (#CCFF00) strictly for interactive triggers, eyebrows, badge accents, and high-impact micro-animations.
Always specify transitions explicitly (e.g. transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300), NEVER use universal 'transition: all'.
Ensure all buttons, form fields, and navigation links feature data-testid attributes for automated test stability.
